description: Sends the channels of a polyphonic signal out one at a time to be processed separately, takes them back, and rebuilds the polyphonic signal

params.text: Chooses whether the eight send and return pairs handle channels 1 to 8 or channels 9 to 16 of the polyphonic signal

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are broken out
Takes that channel back into the rebuilt polyphonic signal; with nothing patched here the channel passes through unchanged

outputs.text: The rebuilt polyphonic signal, carrying the returned voltage for every channel that was sent out and the original voltage for the rest
Monophonic, carrying that one channel of the polyphonic input on its own
